title: Implement 1st order DC blocker and 2nd order post drive tone LPF
description:
Create Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h, Source/DSP/DcBlocker.cpp, Source/DSP/ToneFilter.h, and Source/DSP/ToneFilter.cpp.

DcBlocker: 1st-order high-pass implementing y_dc(n) = x(n) - x(n-1) + R*y_dc(n-1) with R=0.9975. Keep per-channel x(n-1) and y_dc(n-1) state allocated in prepare. This stage is mandatory after the asymmetric waveshaper to remove the DC offset it introduces.

ToneFilter: 2nd-order RBJ low-pass filter with a cutoff adjustable in the 1-16 kHz range. Compute RBJ biquad coefficients from the smoothed cutoff frequency. Use a multiplicative juce::SmoothedValue for the tone cutoff frequency (strictly positive frequency parameter). Provide prepare, reset, setCutoff(float hz), and a process method.

Binding real-time rules: no heap allocation, locks, file IO, or string construction in the per-sample/processBlock path; instantiate juce::ScopedNoDenormals at the top of any block-processing method; allocate all state during prepare.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/TransientShaper.h (d.1) or another existing Source/DSP header for prepare/reset/process conventions and include-guard/namespace style.
- CMakeLists.txt to understand Source/DSP compilation (do not modify it here).
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp for biquad/IIR coefficient helpers and juce::SmoothedValue (read only; do not modify JUCE/).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h/.cpp implement y_dc(n) = x(n) - x(n-1) + R*y_dc(n-1) with R=0.9975 and per-channel state
Source/DSP/ToneFilter.h/.cpp implement a 2nd-order RBJ low-pass with a 1-16 kHz cutoff smoothed multiplicatively
Both classes expose prepare, reset, and a process method following the established Source/DSP conventions
juce::ScopedNoDenormals is instantiated at the top of the block-processing methods and no heap allocation occurs in the per-sample path
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the DC blocker coefficient R=0.9975
perform heap allocation, locking, or string construction inside the per-sample processing path

allowed: add private RBJ coefficient computation helper for ToneFilter
use juce::SmoothedValue with multiplicative smoothing for the tone cutoff
forbidden: combine the two filters into a single class
